LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive time series area chart powered by D3.js with stacked/overlapping modes and gradient fill.

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date/datetime field for X-axis

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field for Y-axis

property.name: seriesField
property.label: Series Field
property.description: Optional field to split into multiple areas (e.g., StageName)

property.name: dateFormat
property.label: Date Format
property.description: Date format for parsing: ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), US (MM/DD/YYYY), EU (DD/MM/YYYY)

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object to query. When set (and no records are passed in), the chart self-fetches this object via GraphQL for the Date and Value fields. Also used for drill-down navigation on area click.

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Date Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: graphqlQuery
property.label: GraphQL Query
property.description: Optional override of the built query. Must be a UI API record query (uiapi.query) whose node selects the Date Field, Value Field, and (if set) Series Field as top-level fields; the returned rows are charted client-side as a time series. UI-API-queryable objects only; at most 2,000 records; GraphQL syntax. Footgun: if the Value Field is missing from the query, points chart as zero rather than erroring. Leave blank to build the query automatically.

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Record Type
propertyType.description: SObject type for the record collection

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date field

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field

property.name: showLegend
property.label: Show Legend
property.description: Show a series legend (defaults to on for multi-series)
